integrity: The four explicit witnesses and direct finite recurrence checker are embedded and reproducible with the Python standard library. This is a self-review, not independent verification or a priority certificate.
scientific_limitations: New assertion is only the unique first entropy-bound failure at two chains of total size seven, profile (3,4); smaller-case saturation is proved. The already known all-length two-row ideal recurrence is excluded from novelty. No unrestricted Littlestone formula for longer chains is asserted. Historical priority remains uncertain.
title: The first entropy obstruction for two-chain comparison shattering
